message.reasoning_content: The service survived across calls and curl returned the exact body, hash matches. Now stop it explicitly and verify.
message.content: Verified: HTTP 200, body hash matches `p6-service-ok`. Now stop the service and confirm it's gone.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "cd \"$(pwd)\"; PID=$(cat service.pid); echo \"stopping pid=$PID\"; kill \"$PID\"; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do sleep 0.4; if ! kill -0 \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; done; if kill -0 \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; then echo \"still alive; SIGKILL\"; kill -9 \"$PID\"; sleep 0.5; fi; if kill -0 \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; then echo \"STOP FAILED\"; else echo \"STOPPED: pid $PID no longer alive\"; fi; echo \"--- curl after stop (expect failure) ---\"; curl -sS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8765/health; echo \"curl_exit=$?\"; echo \"--- port check ---\"; (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8765) || echo \"no listener on 8765\"; echo \"--- service.txt (untouched) ---\"; cat service.txt; echo; sha256sum service.txt"}
